map_info.name: Facade_Florence_Marble
map_info.description: Surfaced actualization — smooth-marble variant. Where Facade_Rustication concentrates the surface axis through Naples-style diamond bossing, this map concentrates the same axis through Florence's smooth dressed-marble vocabulary. Same compositional logic at the surface axis, different material voice. Stamped from commons/maps/rules/facade_placement.md.

learning_objectives: Recognise the surfaced actualization-mode in a different material voice than Naples diamond
Read smooth ashlar marble as a distinct surface-axis position from rusticated stone
Identify what the same compositional principle says when its surface vocabulary changes

map_info.title: The Principle Surfaced — Florence Marble

sp.name: Spawn
sp.description: Player spawn point — back-centre, facing the marble facade

documentation.summary: Facade_Florence_Marble — the principle surfaced via smooth Florentine marble. Stamp variant of the surfaced tag.
documentation.layout: 10×6 walkable space per R3. Spawn at (5,5) back-centre. Teleporter at (3,9) side-front. Facade composes at (1,5) facing spawn.
documentation.objective: Demonstrate the surfaced tag's vocabulary range: the same axis-position (surface as voice) can speak through smooth marble or through Naples diamond. Florence and Naples are both Italian-Renaissance, both 'surfaced', both legibly different.
